results.title: Canyon is rated "Excellent" with 4.5 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
When I asked to speak to a supervisor or for another contact, I was told the only options are the contact form or chat – the same channel that has been going nowhere for a month.  
  
The app connection (theft protection, GPS tracking) is one of the main features Canyon advertises for the Spectral:ON and part of why I chose this bike. I paid a premium price for an e-bike and still can't use features it's sold with – because of an account reset nobody seems responsible for.  
  
The bike rides well. The after-sales service has been very disappointing. I've now filed a formal complaint and will update this review if Canyon resolves it. [...] ## Terrible Reliability and Even Worse Customer Service
I purchased my Canyon Spectral on May 1, 2024, and it has been an absolute nightmare.  
  
In November 2024, just six months after purchasing the bike, I was notified of a battery recall and instructed to stop riding it immediately. It wasn't until June 2025, seven months later, that a replacement battery was finally shipped and I could ride again. [...] ## Delivered on 17 September – app still not working 7 weeks later
I bought a Spectral:ON CF 8 from the Canyon outlet. It was delivered on 17 September and from day one it couldn't be paired with the Canyon App. On 8 October Canyon support told me the cause: the bike was never unlinked from the previous owner's account. In other words, a simple reset on Canyon's side.  
  
Since then:  
– 8 Oct: "forwarded to HQ, we'll let you know"  
– 26 Oct: "colleagues haven't done the reset yet, I'll send an urgent request"  
– 5 Nov: my follow-up email – no reply yet  
– 6 Nov, live chat: "I can see the reset request, but colleagues haven't got to it yet" and "I can't tell you when"
